text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed python SDK v0.12.1 returns embeddings wrapped in an object while the REST API returns a raw list of vectors. Breaking our sampleapp onboarding tests.
kevin: Ugh. SDK should mirror REST here. Is it data[0].embedding vs top-level list?
maria: Exactly. REST `/v1/embeddings` -> `[[0.1, 0.2, ...]]`. SDK `client.embeddings.create(...)` -> `{'data':[{'embedding':[0.1,0.2,...]}],'usage':{...}}`.
ash: Can you paste the minimal curl + python snippets?
maria: curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-1","input":"hello"}'
```
REST returns:
```
[[0.1,0.2,0.3]]
```
python sdk:
```
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="embed-1", input="hello")
# resp == {'data':[{'embedding':[0.1,0.2,0.3]}], 'usage':{...}}
```
tyler: That shape difference makes parsing boilerplate everywhere. We should either make SDK return the raw list (parity) or add a `raw` flag. Both ok but keep parity by default.
kevin: There's also a retry semantics mismatch I spotted: REST 429 returns `Retry-After` and our HTTP client respects it; SDK v0.12.1 currently does fixed immediate retries (no honor of Retry-After). Filed an issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/512
devex-bot: New issue created by kevin: "sdk/512 — embeddings response shape + retry-after not honored"
maria: Sampleapp tests fail because onboarding script expects `list[float]` for embeddings. CI noise and new users hitting this during quickstart is bad UX.
ash: I'll add a small adapter in sample-apps to unwrap the shape for now and add a test that fails if shape changes. Opening PR shortly.
tyler: Workaround on app side: `vec = resp['data'][0]['embedding']` but that leaks non-parity knowledge into app code.
kevin: I'll ping runtime team in eng-runtime to confirm we haven't changed REST shape recently. If REST is canonical, SDK should adapt. Also will add honoring `Retry-After` header in SDK HTTP retry logic.
maria: Thanks. Can SDK team target a hotfix release for parity+retry fix? This is blocking new-user onboarding and docs examples.
kevin: Yes — planning hotfix: 0.12.2 within 48h, stable 0.13.0 with tests in 2 weeks. Assigning to @sdk-maintainers. :thumbsup:
ash: PR with sampleapp adapter: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/98 (draft)
maria: I'll update quickstart docs to note the temporary adapter and add a regression test in onboarding checklist.
kevin: Filed internal task: INF-2243 to add an integration test comparing SDK vs REST responses for core endpoints (embeddings, chat, generation).
maria: Great — please add changelog entry and a short note in the migration guide.
kevin: On it. Will also add an issue to check other endpoints for similar parameter/shape drift.
